terms_note: Not live-verified: built from BFL's API documentation read on 2026-11-02, with no live call. 1 credit is $0.01. The per-image prices for FLUX1.1 [pro], its Ultra mode and Kontext were blank in the documentation pages as fetched, so their table rows are planning proxies taken from Replicate's published prices for the same models, and the real charge is read from the submit response's cost field (credits). Delivery URLs expire after 10 minutes, so results are downloaded at once. None of these models documents native transparency. Check each model's license terms before shipping its output.

models.notes: First output megapixel $0.03, each further input or output megapixel $0.015 (bfl.ai/pricing structured data and fal's matching row, read 2026-11-02). Up to 8 reference images through input_image to input_image_8. The documentation gives no multiple or maximum for width and height, so 16 px steps and a 2048 px edge follow the same model on Replicate. Prompt upsampling is switched off with disable_pup. Not live-verified.
